page.title: 回数と確からしさを表す

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、once・twice・three times で出来事の回数を数える表現と、definitely・certainly・surely・probably・maybe・perhaps・possibly で話し手の確信度を示す方法を扱う。確信度副詞は位置と強さが異なり、maybe・perhaps は文頭に置きやすく、probably・definitely などは一般動詞の前や最初の助動詞の後に置く。
grammarPoints: once は1回、twice は2回、three times 以降は数 + times で回数を表す
回数表現は文末に置くのが基本で、期間を続けて頻度も示せる
definitely・certainly は非常に高い確信を示す
probably は可能性が高いが確実ではないことを示す
possibly は可能性を控えめに示す
maybe・perhaps は節全体にかかり、文頭に置きやすい
surely は話し手の強い期待・当然という判断を含むことがある
visualEvidence: once・twice・three times の回数カードが、1・2・3個の印と対応している
確信度メーターが possibly・maybe・perhaps・probably・certainly・definitely を弱い側から強い側へ配置している
一般動詞の前、be動詞の後、最初の助動詞の後という三つの位置レールが描かれている
maybe・perhaps のカードが文頭の吹き出しへ移され、文全体への推量を示している
commonTraps: two times を常に誤りと考え、自然な twice を選べない
three time のように複数回なのに times を単数にする
definitely と probably を同じ確信度で解釈する
maybe を助動詞 may be と混同する
確信度副詞を助動詞の前後で不自然な位置に置く
surely を単なる probably と考え、話し手の期待を読み落とす

questions.prompt: The applicant called the recruitment office ------- yesterday to confirm the interview time.

choices.A: twice
choices.B: once every two days
choices.C: two time
choices.D: probably

questions.translationJa: 応募者は面接時刻を確認するため、昨日採用窓口に2回電話しました。
questions.explanationJa: twice は「2回」を表し、回数を文末で示します。two time は times が必要です。

questions.prompt: The package will ------- arrive by noon because it is already at the local distribution center.

choices.A: definite
choices.B: probably
choices.C: once
choices.D: three times

questions.translationJa: 荷物はすでに地域配送センターにあるため、おそらく正午までに到着します。
questions.explanationJa: 到着の可能性は高いものの断定はできないため probably が適切です。助動詞 will の後に置きます。

questions.prompt: We have ------- received the signed contract; the original is in the legal department’s safe.

choices.A: maybe
choices.B: twice
choices.C: definitely
choices.D: possible

questions.translationJa: 署名済み契約書を確実に受け取っており、原本は法務部の金庫にあります。
questions.explanationJa: 原本の所在まで確認済みなので、高い確信を示す definitely が合います。現在完了では have の後に置きます。

questions.prompt: -------, the client will request another revision after reviewing the new cost estimate.

choices.A: Certain
choices.B: Three times
choices.C: Definite
choices.D: Perhaps

questions.translationJa: おそらく、顧客は新しい費用見積もりを確認した後、再修正を求めるでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: Perhaps は節全体への控えめな推量を表し、文頭に置けます。

questions.prompt: The alarm sounded ------- during the emergency drill before the system was reset.

choices.A: three times
choices.B: third time
choices.C: three time
choices.D: surely

questions.translationJa: システムがリセットされる前、緊急訓練中に警報が3回鳴りました。
questions.explanationJa: 3回以上は数 + times で表すため three times が正解です。

questions.prompt: The museum branch is ------- closed today; an official notice is posted on its entrance.

choices.A: certainty
choices.B: certainly
choices.C: possible
choices.D: once

questions.translationJa: 美術館の分館は今日は確実に休館で、入口に公式の案内が掲示されています。
questions.explanationJa: 公式掲示という根拠があるため、高い確信を表す certainly が自然です。be動詞 is の後に置きます。

questions.prompt: With unanimous support from the review committee, the board will ------- approve the proposal.

choices.A: one time
choices.B: possible
choices.C: surely
choices.D: sure

questions.translationJa: 審査委員会が全会一致で支持しているので、取締役会もきっと提案を承認するでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: surely は根拠に基づく話し手の強い期待を表します。助動詞 will の後に置けます。

questions.prompt: The technician may ------- need a replacement cable if the connector is damaged.

choices.A: definitely always
choices.B: twice
choices.C: certain
choices.D: possibly

questions.translationJa: コネクターが損傷していれば、技術者は交換ケーブルを必要とする可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: may possibly は可能性を控えめに示します。断定的な definitely は条件文の不確実さと合いません。

questions.prompt: I have visited the Osaka office ------- this month, for the annual safety review.

choices.A: once
choices.B: one times
choices.C: probably
choices.D: twice a one

questions.translationJa: 私は今月、年次安全審査のため大阪事業所を1回訪れました。
questions.explanationJa: 1回は once で表します。期間 this month とともに文末に置かれています。

questions.prompt: The refund will ------- appear in your account within five business days, although bank processing times vary.

choices.A: certainly never
choices.B: probably
choices.C: two times
choices.D: definite

questions.translationJa: 返金はおそらく5営業日以内に口座へ反映されますが、銀行の処理時間には差があります。
questions.explanationJa: 処理時間にばらつきがあるため確実ではなく、可能性が高いことを示す probably が適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence confirming that a courier pickup occurred.

choices.A: The courier definitely has collected the parcel from reception.
choices.B: The courier has collected definitely the parcel from reception.
choices.C: The courier has definitely collected the parcel from reception.
choices.D: The courier has definite collected the parcel from reception.

questions.translationJa: 配達員が受付から荷物を確実に引き取りました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了では definitely を最初の助動詞 has の後に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence making a tentative prediction about a meeting.

choices.A: Perhapsly the meeting will end earlier than scheduled.
choices.B: The meeting perhaps will ends earlier than scheduled.
choices.C: Perhaps the meeting will ended earlier than scheduled.
choices.D: Perhaps the meeting will end earlier than scheduled.

questions.translationJa: 会議は予定より早く終わるかもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: Perhaps は文頭で節全体への推量を示し、will の後は動詞原形 end を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting the number of product tests.

choices.A: The device was tested three times before shipment.
choices.B: The device was tested three time before shipment.
choices.C: The device three times was test before shipment.
choices.D: The device was tested third times before shipment.

questions.translationJa: その装置は出荷前に3回試験されました。
questions.explanationJa: 回数は three times とし、受動態の後ろに置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence predicting when a report will be ready.

choices.A: The report probably will ready be by Friday afternoon.
choices.B: The report will probably be ready by Friday afternoon.
choices.C: The report will be probably ready by Friday afternoon always.
choices.D: The report will probable be ready by Friday afternoon.

questions.translationJa: 報告書はおそらく金曜日の午後までに完成します。
questions.explanationJa: probably は助動詞 will の後に置き、will probably be とします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing strong confidence in a candidate.

choices.A: Ms. Singh certainly is qualify for the supervisory role.
choices.B: Ms. Singh is certainty qualified for the supervisory role.
choices.C: Ms. Singh is certainly qualified for the supervisory role.
choices.D: Ms. Singh is qualified certainly for supervisory role the.

questions.translationJa: シンさんは監督職に確実にふさわしい資格を備えています。
questions.explanationJa: be動詞 is の後に certainly を置き、過去分詞形の形容詞 qualified を続けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence allowing for a possible schedule change.

choices.A: We possibly may needed to move the inspection to next week.
choices.B: We may possible need moving the inspection to next week.
choices.C: We may need possibly to moved the inspection to next week.
choices.D: We may possibly need to move the inspection to next week.

questions.translationJa: 検査を来週へ移す必要が生じる可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: 助動詞 may の後に possibly、その後に動詞原形 need を置く形が自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting two calls received this morning.

choices.A: The customer called twice this morning about the missing invoice.
choices.B: The customer called two time this morning about the missing invoice.
choices.C: The customer twice called this morning about missing invoice the.
choices.D: The customer called second times this morning about the missing invoice.

questions.translationJa: 顧客は不足している請求書について今朝2回電話しました。
questions.explanationJa: 2回は twice で表し、時間句 this morning とともに文末に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence showing that the speaker expects agreement about an error.

choices.A: Sure these totals cannot correctly be after such a large discrepancy.
choices.B: Surely these totals cannot be correct after such a large discrepancy.
choices.C: These totals surely cannot correct be after such a large discrepancy.
choices.D: Surely these totals cannot are correct after such a large discrepancy.

questions.translationJa: これほど大きな差がある以上、この合計が正しいはずはありません。
questions.explanationJa: 文頭の Surely は「当然そうだろう」という強い判断を示し、cannot be correct が文法的に続きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence making a likely but uncertain progress estimate.

choices.A: The installation team probably has complete the first floor by now.
choices.B: The installation team has completed probably the first floor by now.
choices.C: The installation team has probably completed the first floor by now.
choices.D: The installation team has probable completed the first floor by now.

questions.translationJa: 設置チームは今ごろおそらく1階を完了しています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了では probably を最初の助動詞 has の後に置き、過去分詞 completed を続けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence offering an informal tentative suggestion.

choices.A: May be we should rescheduled the customer demonstration.
choices.B: We should maybe to reschedule the customer demonstration.
choices.C: Maybe should we reschedules the customer demonstration.
choices.D: Maybe we should reschedule the customer demonstration.

questions.translationJa: 顧客向け実演を日程変更した方がよいかもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: 1語の Maybe は文頭で「もしかすると」を表します。may be は助動詞 + be で別の構造です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The shipment will definitely leave today.”

choices.A: There is no doubt that the shipment will depart today.
choices.B: The shipment may be canceled today.
choices.C: The shipment left twice yesterday.
choices.D: It is unlikely that the shipment will leave today.

questions.translationJa: その荷物は今日必ず出発します。
questions.explanationJa: definitely は疑いがない非常に高い確信を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The supplier will probably accept the revised terms.”

choices.A: The supplier has already rejected all terms with certainty.
choices.B: It is more likely than not that the supplier will accept the revised terms.
choices.C: The supplier must accept the terms without exception.
choices.D: The supplier reviewed the terms twice.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先はおそらく改訂条件を受け入れるでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: probably は可能性が高いものの、確実ではないことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The delay could possibly affect tomorrow’s delivery.”

choices.A: The delay will certainly cancel every delivery.
choices.B: Tomorrow’s delivery cannot be affected.
choices.C: There is some chance that the delay will affect tomorrow’s delivery.
choices.D: The delivery was delayed three times yesterday.

questions.translationJa: その遅れは明日の配送に影響する可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: possibly は「可能性はある」という控えめな推量です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The client called twice.”

choices.A: The client called every two days.
choices.B: The client made one call.
choices.C: The client probably did not call.
choices.D: The client made two calls.

questions.translationJa: 顧客は2回電話しました。
questions.explanationJa: twice は two times、つまり2回です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The equipment is calibrated three times a year.”

choices.A: Calibration is performed on three occasions each year.
choices.B: Calibration takes three years each time.
choices.C: The equipment is calibrated once every three years.
choices.D: The equipment is never calibrated.

questions.translationJa: その機器は年3回校正されます。
questions.explanationJa: three times a year は各年に3回行うことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Maybe the branch will extend its hours.”

choices.A: The branch will certainly shorten its hours.
choices.B: Perhaps the branch will stay open longer.
choices.C: The branch has extended its hours twice already.
choices.D: The branch is never open.

questions.translationJa: その支店は営業時間を延長するかもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: maybe と perhaps はどちらも節全体への控えめな推量を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Surely the director knows about the change.”

choices.A: The speaker believes the director definitely knows nothing.
choices.B: The director learned about the change only once.
choices.C: The speaker strongly expects that the director knows about the change.
choices.D: It is impossible for the director to know.

questions.translationJa: きっと部長はその変更を知っているはずです。
questions.explanationJa: surely は話し手の強い期待や「当然そうだ」という判断を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The committee meets once every quarter.”

choices.A: The committee meets once every four years.
choices.B: The committee meets three times each week.
choices.C: The committee never meets during a quarter.
choices.D: The committee meets four times in a typical year.

questions.translationJa: 委員会は四半期に1回会合を開きます。
questions.explanationJa: 1年に四半期は4回あるため、once every quarter は通常年4回です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The figures are certainly accurate.”

choices.A: The speaker is highly confident that the figures are correct.
choices.B: The figures are only possibly correct.
choices.C: The figures were counted twice but remain unknown.
choices.D: The speaker expects the figures to be wrong.

questions.translationJa: その数値は確実に正確です。
questions.explanationJa: certainly は非常に高い確信を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Mr. Lee has probably left the office.”

choices.A: Mr. Lee definitely remains in the office.
choices.B: It is likely, but not certain, that Mr. Lee has departed.
choices.C: Mr. Lee left and returned three times.
choices.D: There is no possibility that Mr. Lee left.

questions.translationJa: リーさんはおそらく退社しました。
questions.explanationJa: probably は「可能性が高いが確実ではない」という意味です。

questions.prompt: Tracking shows that the parcel reached the customer’s local delivery depot at 6:00 A.M. No exception notice is displayed. -------

choices.A: It definitely arrived three days ago.
choices.B: It can never be delivered.
choices.C: It will probably arrive today.
choices.D: It will arrive twice today.

questions.translationJa: 追跡情報では荷物は午前6時に顧客地域の配送拠点へ到着し、例外通知はありません。おそらく今日届きます。
questions.explanationJa: 根拠から可能性は高いものの配達完了前なので probably が適切です。

questions.prompt: The chief executive signed the proposal, and the approval stamp appears on every page. -------

choices.A: The proposal may not have been reviewed at all.
choices.B: The proposal was approved twice every page.
choices.C: Maybe the signature belongs to no one.
choices.D: The proposal has definitely been approved.

questions.translationJa: 最高経営責任者が提案書へ署名し、全ページに承認印があります。提案書は確実に承認済みです。
questions.explanationJa: 署名と承認印という確認済み証拠があるため definitely が最適です。

questions.prompt: The phone log shows two incoming calls from the same customer at 9:10 and 9:24. -------

choices.A: The customer called twice.
choices.B: The customer called once every two weeks.
choices.C: The customer probably never called.
choices.D: The customer called three times a day.

questions.translationJa: 電話記録には同じ顧客から午前9時10分と9時24分の2件の着信があります。顧客は2回電話しました。
questions.explanationJa: 記録された着信が2件なので twice を使います。
questions.focus: 記録から twice を判断

questions.prompt: A storm is developing offshore, but forecasters are unsure of its path. -------

choices.A: The evening flight is certainly already canceled.
choices.B: The evening flight could possibly be delayed.
choices.C: The flight was delayed twice yesterday, so it must be today.
choices.D: The evening flight definitely cannot be affected.

questions.translationJa: 沖合で嵐が発達していますが、予報担当者は進路を確定できていません。夕方便が遅れる可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: 進路が不確かなので、控えめな可能性を表す could possibly が合います。

questions.prompt: The quality engineer repeated the pressure cycle at low, medium, and high settings. -------

choices.A: The component was tested once.
choices.B: The component was never tested.
choices.C: The component was tested three times.
choices.D: The component was tested every three years.

questions.translationJa: 品質技術者は圧力サイクルを低・中・高の設定で繰り返しました。部品は3回試験されました。
questions.explanationJa: 異なる3設定で1回ずつなので three times とまとめられます。

questions.prompt: The invoice total is $18,000, but its listed items add up to only $12,000. A reviewer reacts: “-------”

choices.A: Possibly this total is definitely perfect.
choices.B: This total called twice.
choices.C: Maybe the total certainly has no discrepancy.
choices.D: Surely this total cannot be correct.

questions.translationJa: 請求書合計は1万8,000ドルですが、明細の合計は1万2,000ドルです。確認者は「この合計が正しいはずはありません」と反応します。
questions.explanationJa: 明白な不一致への強い判断には Surely ... cannot be correct が自然です。

questions.prompt: The proposed date conflicts with two major client visits. The coordinator wants to make a tentative suggestion. -------

choices.A: Maybe we should choose a different date.
choices.B: We definitely chose the date last year.
choices.C: We should choose the date three times.
choices.D: Surely the conflict is impossible to consider.

questions.translationJa: 提案日は2件の主要顧客訪問と重なります。担当者は控えめに「別の日を選んだ方がよいかもしれません」と提案します。
questions.explanationJa: 控えめで会話的な提案には文頭の Maybe が適切です。
questions.focus: Maybe で提案を和らげる

questions.prompt: The inventory system and a physical count both show zero replacement motors in stock. -------

choices.A: The motors are probably counted twice and therefore plentiful.
choices.B: The motors are certainly unavailable at present.
choices.C: The motors may definitely be in stock elsewhere in the same bin.
choices.D: The motors were available three times yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 在庫システムと実地棚卸しの両方で交換用モーターの在庫はゼロです。現在、確実に利用できません。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの確認結果が一致しているため高い確信を示す certainly が合います。

questions.prompt: Ms. Brown attended the international conference in 2019 and has not returned since then. -------

choices.A: She attends it twice every year.
choices.B: She has probably attended it three times.
choices.C: She has attended the conference once.
choices.D: She never attended the conference in 2019.

questions.translationJa: ブラウンさんは2019年に国際会議へ参加し、それ以降は参加していません。参加回数は1回です。
questions.explanationJa: 参加事実が1度だけなので once が正解です。

questions.prompt: The weather service gives a 70 percent chance of rain during the outdoor ceremony. -------

choices.A: It will definitely remain dry.
choices.B: It may rain exactly twice.
choices.C: Rain is certainly impossible at 70 percent.
choices.D: It will probably rain during the ceremony.

questions.translationJa: 気象情報では屋外式典中の降水確率は70パーセントです。式典中はおそらく雨が降るでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: 70パーセントは可能性が高いが確実ではないため probably が適切です。
